---
title: "Deployment configuration"
description: "Where Tuturuuu configuration lives, and the rules for handling it safely."
updatedAt: '2026-10-31'
---

Tuturuuu separates code from configuration. Code and the names of
configuration values are public in this repository; values are not.

## Rules

- Hosted deployment credentials live in environment-scoped GitHub Actions
  secrets.
- Runtime and build-time configuration for hosted apps lives in the hosting
  provider's project environment, not in workflow-wide variables.
- Local development reads `apps/web/.env.local` (copy the checked-in example and
  fill in your own values).
- Never commit tokens, keys, passwords or rendered environment dumps, and do not
  edit checked-in compose files to inject per-environment secrets.
- Rotate a credential independently of unrelated ones, and revoke it when its
  purpose ends.
- Each app's documentation lists the configuration names it reads and whether
  each is required, optional or server-only.

## Self-hosting and local development

See [Without Docker](/build/development-tools/without-docker) and
[Local Supabase development](/build/development-tools/local-supabase-development)
for running the maintained apps on your own machine, and the
[DevOps overview](/build/devops/overview) for the delivery surfaces.
